title: Autopoies Browser Connect site adapter
description: YAML adapter that defines named commands for a website. Loaded by ap-browser CLI at runtime from ~/.ap-browser/sites/.

site.description: Site folder name; must match the parent directory. E.g. 'hackernews', 'bilibili'.

name.description: Command name; must match the YAML filename without extension. E.g. 'top', 'search'.

description.description: One-line human-readable summary of what this command does.

args.description: Declared arguments. Each key is the arg name; value is an arg definition.

input.description: Optional pipe-input spec. When present, the adapter accepts NDJSON from stdin and auto-maps fields to args.

output.description: Optional output declaration. Helps pipe-downstream validation.

steps.description: Ordered list of step primitives. Each step is a single-key object mapping method name to params.

field.description: Arg name to fill from each NDJSON record's same-named field.

eval.description: JavaScript expression to evaluate via CDP.

text.description: CSS selector to extract text from.
